The Export button now works, and the fix is committed as `2c64c94`.

**Cause:** `OrdersPage.export()` existed, but `__init__` only registered the `refresh` handler. Clicking `export` found no handler and returned silently.

**Fix:** `src/orders-web/orders_page.py` registers `export` alongside `refresh`. I also added `test_export_button_writes_one_download` in `tests/test_orders_web.py`, which clicks the button. The new test fails on the old code and passes with the fix. All 9 tests pass, run with `PYTHONPATH=src/orders-web python3 -m unittest`.

The README's `python3 -m unittest` command doesn't work as written, because the tests import from `src/orders-web` and nothing puts that directory on the path. I didn't change that.

I left your uncommitted README note ("ask whether Export should include cancelled orders") and the untracked `notes/` directory out of the commit. The export still includes cancelled orders, since it writes every order in `self.orders`. Changing that is a separate decision.
